subject.title: feat(ui): docs, help, Discord, and changelog links in the agent chip menu

question: Should the Control UI agent-chip menu permanently promote Help, Discord community, and release notes alongside Docs once the responsive overflow is fixed?
rationale: Code review can verify rendering and navigation mechanics, but the permanent set and prominence of external product-chrome destinations is a product-support decision that the protected maintainer label leaves to an owner.

options.title: Approve all four links
options.body: Keep Docs, Help, Discord, and release notes after the viewport fix and real browser proof are added.

options.title: Narrow the destination set
options.body: Retain only owner-approved destinations, such as Docs and Help, to reduce menu density and product-chrome commitments.

options.title: Decline the expansion
options.body: Close the PR and keep the existing Docs-only menu if community and release links should remain outside primary product chrome.

recommendation.title: Approve all four links
recommendation.body: Keep Docs, Help, Discord, and release notes after the viewport fix and real browser proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history shows direct ownership of the newly merged agent-chip menu and this proposed destination expansion.
